scenarios.hypothesis: Policy decisions may differ incorrectly when equivalent requests originate from sources with different trust labels.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A mocked test sink records a synthetic marker and the normalized policy decision.
scenarios.positive_control: An explicitly approved synthetic request reaches the inert test sink.
scenarios.negative_control: A non-approved synthetic source cannot cause the same test action.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop before any production or third-party action and keep all effects inside the controlled fixture.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: Source-aware policy blocks the non-approved path while preserving the approved synthetic control.

scenarios.hypothesis: A test identity may observe state that belongs only to a neighboring test identity when isolation is incomplete.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A unique synthetic canary is observed only inside the controlled test environment.
scenarios.positive_control: The owning test identity can read its own synthetic canary.
scenarios.negative_control: A neighboring test identity cannot read that canary under the same controlled query.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop if validation would leave the dedicated sandbox or use non-test data.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: Identity binding blocks the neighboring path while the owning identity still succeeds.

scenarios.hypothesis: A confirmation decision may remain valid after the normalized action tuple changes.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A controlled test sink compares the confirmed synthetic tuple with the executed tuple.
scenarios.positive_control: The exact confirmed synthetic tuple is accepted by the inert sink.
scenarios.negative_control: Changing one bounded tuple field causes the inert sink to reject the request.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop before any action outside the inert test sink.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: Confirmation is bound to the complete normalized synthetic tuple and neighboring intended behavior remains available.
